fields.source_or_lean_encoding: InitialVelocityConditionDecay u₀ requires smoothness, divergence-free initial data, and all-order rapid spatial decay; the analytical source uses the stronger special witness u₀ = 0.

fields.clay_requirement: there exists smooth rapidly decaying f satisfying Fefferman condition (5)
fields.source_or_lean_encoding: ForceConditionDecay f requires smoothness on t ≥ 0 and all-order rapid decay in space and time; the analytical source states a smooth compactly supported force, a stronger admissible special case.
NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness.navier_stokes encodes ∂t v + (v·∇)v = nu Δv - ∇p + f on t ≥ 0.
NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness.div_free requires divergence zero for all x and t ≥ 0.
NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness.initial_condition requires v x 0 = u₀ x.

fields.clay_requirement: bounded kinetic energy for all t ≥ 0
fields.source_or_lean_encoding: NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn requires per-time L2 membership and a uniform global kinetic-energy bound.
